components.name: Lamp Button
components.description: The one warm thing you can press on a dusk screen.
components.css: .ds-stage { background: var(--color-dusk-1, #0E1432); padding: 24px; } .ds-lamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-lamp, #FFC46B); color: var(--color-dusk-1, #0E1432); font: 600 1.0625rem Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 34px -8px rgb(255 196 107 / .55); cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s; } .ds-lamp:hover { background: var(--color-lamp-soft, #FFE3B0); } .ds-lamp:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(255 196 107 / .4); }

components.name: Lit Window
components.description: The signature: a window that comes on, catching, dipping, then holding.
components.css: .ds-stage { background: var(--color-dusk-1, #0E1432); padding: 24px; } .ds-glass { animation: ds-lamp-on 1.1s ease-out both; } @keyframes ds-lamp-on { 0% { opacity: 0; } 30% { opacity: .75; } 45% { opacity: .4; } 100% { opacity: 1; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-glass { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
A home is the people lit up inside it. Everything outside the house is one dusk: a drenched blue sky with a band of last light on the horizon, a dark street, and a house at street scale whose windows belong to the family. Each person is a window. It stays dark until they answer, and the room in the middle lights last, from the real overlap in the family's tastes.

The product moves through three places, and each has its own material. Outdoors (landing, the Heart, the private link, the workspace hero) is dusk blue with warm lamp light. Indoors (plan, lists, brief, concepts) is lamp-lit warm paper, where the family has stepped inside to work. The House view is a heads-up display of glass floating over the 3D home. Dusk is sparse and set large, with one sentence and one thing to press. Indoors is calm and denser, a working room with tools in reach.

This is a replacement world. It retires the cream ground with a saffron-to-plum gradient, the Plus Jakarta Sans display and the style-quiz card grid. The signature motion is a lamp coming on: it catches, dips, then holds, slowly and physically, and it has an instant equivalent under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Dusk blue ground, warm light as the only warm colour on screen
Lit shapes on the dusk, with no boxed cards
One display voice set large in the sky, Geist for everything you operate
A house pinned to the foot of the viewport, copy in the sky above it
Warm paper and brown shadows indoors, glass over 3D
Pills for every action, underlines for fields on dusk

rules.name: The Lamp Means Someone Rule
rules.body: On the dusk, warm light belongs to a person or something a person does: a window they lit, their dot, the thing they chose, the one button they can press. The horizon and the neighbours' windows are the only other warmth, and they are scenery.

rules.name: The Three Worlds Rule
rules.body: Lamp lives outdoors, jamun lives indoors, HUD pink lives over 3D. A screen sits in one world. Indoors, lamp appears only as a small ring or dot on the family's own chosen or live thing.

rules.name: The Earned Light Rule
rules.body: The heart's light comes from data. It never lights on a guess, a timer or a loading state.

rules.name: The Compliance Hues Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red mean rule outcomes and errors, indoors, and nothing else.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: What the house says is Bricolage 700. What you operate is Geist. A line of dusk copy is one or the other, with no third voice.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: All type is sentence case with tight or neutral tracking. There are no eyebrows and no uppercase labels.

rules.name: The Street Scale Rule
rules.body: On dusk screens the house is pinned to the foot of the viewport at full width, taking 38 to 58dvh and passing no pointer events. Copy sits in the sky above it on a higher layer. The drawing crops from the bottom centre, so the ground stays on the floor of the screen at any aspect ratio. Keep text above the 86% stop of the sky, since Dusk Ink Muted falls to 1.1:1 on the horizon band.

rules.name: The Light Is Lift Rule
rules.body: On dusk, a thing comes forward by glowing. Indoors it comes forward on a brown shadow. Neutral black shadows do not appear on paper.

dos: Do build every outdoor screen from the sky and the one Lamp Button, with one sentence and the house below.
Do use Display Words in Lamp Soft for anything the family actually shares, and only that.
Do step indoors for work: plan, lists, brief and concepts go on Warm Ivory with Warm White surfaces.
Do use `glass-hud` for anything floating over the 3D house, with the two-tone HUD focus ring.
Do tint indoor shadows brown (`rgb(74 52 30)`), matching e1 to e3.
Do give every lit moment a reduced-motion state and a text equivalent.
Do use `--ease-out` and the shared spring (stiffness 380, damping 34) for interface motion, and keep the slow lamp timing for lights only.
Do use the family's own words and pictures as the visual content; a thumbnail is a circle.
donts: Don't put a boxed card around a control on the dusk.
Don't add a warm colour outdoors that isn't lamp light, the horizon or a neighbour's window.
Don't light the heart before the overlap is real.
Don't bring back the saffron-to-plum gradient, Plus Jakarta Sans, or the `taste-*` colours on new surfaces.
Don't use jamun or the compliance hues on dusk, or lamp as an indoor accent.
Don't set text on the horizon band.
Don't use eyebrows, uppercase labels or positive display tracking.
Don't set reading text in Ink Faint.
Don't name a data source anywhere in the app; the feature speaks in its own words.
